The '''Kalishik system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was the location of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalishik]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[T'sarki]].<ref name="TEA" />
